headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 24, 2026**
article:
The Atlanta Braves secured a thrilling 6-5 victory over the San Diego Padres, with Chris Sale earning the win after 6.0 innings of work, striking out 11 and allowing 3 earned runs. Dominic Smith led the Padres with 1 home run and 3 RBIs.

Injuries and availability impacted several teams, with Rafael Flores Jr. being placed on the 7-day injured list by the Pittsburgh Pirates due to a concussion. The Philadelphia Phillies transferred Brad Keller to the 60-day injured list with a right elbow UCL tear and placed Rafael Marchán on the 10-day injured list with left knee patellar tendinitis. The Toronto Blue Jays had multiple players placed on the injured list, including Addison Barger with right elbow inflammation, Patrick Corbin with a left teres major strain, and Jonatan Clase with left plantar fasciitis. The Baltimore Orioles placed Samuel Basallo on the 10-day injured list with right shoulder inflammation, and the Athletics placed J.T. Ginn on the 15-day injured list with a right middle finger blister.

Several trades and roster movements occurred, with the Pittsburgh Pirates acquiring Ron Marinaccio from the San Diego Padres for future considerations. The Houston Astros traded Nate Pearson to the Kansas City Royals for Max Martin, while the Colorado Rockies traded Seth Halvorsen to the Los Angeles Dodgers for Nick Frasso and Landyn Vidourek. The Athletics traded Aaron Civale to the Chicago Cubs for Aiden Moffett.

top_news.title: **Braves Edge Padres in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured a 6-5 victory over the San Diego Padres, with Chris Sale earning the win after 6.0 innings of work, striking out 11 and allowing 3 earned runs. Dominic Smith led the Padres with 1 home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Guardians in 3-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 3-1 win over the Cleveland Guardians, with Patrick Bailey leading the offense with a home run and one RBI.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Rays 3-1**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 3-1 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, with Shane Bieber earning the win and Louis Varland securing the save.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Take Down Cardinals 10-6**
top_news.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks secured a 10-6 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Tyler Locklear leading the offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Brandon Pfaadt earned the win for the Diamondbacks.

top_news.title: **Rockies Take Down Brewers 5-2**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies secured a 5-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers, with standout performances from Kyle Karros and TJ Rumfield. Shane Drohan led the Rockies' pitching staff to the win.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall Short in Motor City**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers edged the Kansas City Royals 2-1, securing a narrow victory. Tarik Skubal and the Tigers' pitching staff played a key role in the win, while Hao-Yu Lee was a standout hitter for the Royals.

top_news.title: **Pirates Place Rafael Flores Jr. on 7-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Rafael Flores Jr., catcher for the Pittsburgh Pirates, has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion, effective retroactive to July 23, 2026.

top_news.title: **Pirates Acquire Marinaccio in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates have acquired right-handed pitcher Ron Marinaccio in a trade with the San Diego Padres. Marinaccio joins the Pirates in exchange for future considerations.
